title: Deconstructing a Flawed Argument
grammar: Using concessive indefinites and disjunctive logic to expose contradictions
goal: I can deconstruct a flawed or circular argument using bár-... is, akár... akár..., and tekintet nélkül arra, hogy.
I can expose hidden false premises (reдукció ad absurdum) in Hungarian debate.
I can read and analyze István Örkény's Egyperces novellák at B2 level.
